coverage: Each execution path covers 4 weapons x 6 enemy hulls, all 5 player hulls, normal/boss/ultimate display sizes, launch anchors, actual impacts, feedback anchors and incoming target centre. Pulse uses fixed-ray hull surface; beam, guided missile and ordinary rail use their existing centre endpoints. Not a claim of equal hit timing versus the former incorrect GDScript geometry.

authorities.encounter_scale: Game publishes encounter_leader and hull_scale on the actor at birth. All geometry and drawing read the same width; dead and residual references retain it. Older manual receipts acquire missing metadata at restoration.
authorities.model_origin: Enemy alpha bounds centre rebases sprite and all authored hardpoints at load. Player whole-assembly transform uses imported XZ bounds centre, including socket chains. Auxiliary drones/carriers are not damage targets; their full root/socket transform remains shared.
authorities.residence: Existing pose owns final location and entry progress. Fixed layout is enabled for both execution paths. Resident clamping precedes entry translation; stationary clocks do not regenerate geometry.
authorities.return: Existing single Game restores scalar actor/flight graph. Retired native display lease is excluded only from serialization. Scene gate stops later native substeps while preserving debt; no second Game or wall-time catch-up.

findings.gdscript_offset: Presented fire used projected logical aim, but display reconstructed the straight segment from raw target.x/y. New births carry committed projected aim/ray; GDScript pulse uses the same hull contact publisher as native.
findings.entry: Top clamp had shortened first-row entry to roughly8px. Authored50px travel is now separate from final bounds. Real stage1 tested in both execution paths.
findings.dead_target: Legal double-pulse loadout: no primary birth after target death; already-fired pulse serials survive and continue straight. No attack rate, damage, drop or lifetime reduction.
findings.residual_return: Nonempty native-born flights formerly carried an unserializable retired motion lease after handoff. Scalar graph now roundtrips; blocked transition does not advance/render restored flights.

prior_test_limitation: Existing legacy player defence timing fixture has four-argument override against six-argument parent; not passed and no unrelated Lab fix.
